setup_config: setup a DINOv3 configuration from a config file and command line overrides with scaling rules applied
setup_multidistillation: setup a multi-distillation training job with student process subgroups and per-student configurations
setup_job: setup logging, distributed training, and random seeds for a DINOv3 training job
get_default_config: get the default SSL configuration loaded from ssl_default_config.yaml as an OmegaConf DictConfig
exit_job: clean up a DINOv3 job by disabling distributed training and closing logging
